name: com.vpscast/vpscast
title: VPScast
description: VPS prices and benchmarks: find, compare and rank VPS plans, pick a data center near an exchange.

tools.name: find-vps
tools.description: Find VPS plans by place, size, budget and other filters, cheapest first or by benchmark speed. Each plan in its cheapest data center within the place, with the full monthly price in USD (server + IPv4 + disk), stock, our benchmark score and the page on vpscast.com. Pass the plan id to get-vps-plan for details.

place.description: A continent, country or city slug as in /vps/{geo}: "europe", "germany", "frankfurt". Empty: the whole world.

budget.description: At most this many USD a month, full price.

ram.description: At least this many GB of RAM.

disk.description: nvme: only plans on NVMe disks.

cpu.description: dedicated: only plans with dedicated vCPUs, not shared.

billing.description: hourly: only plans billed by the hour.

traffic.description: unmetered: only plans with unmetered traffic.

sort.description: price (default), vcpu/ram/disk (price per unit), score, score_per_usd, cpu_per_usd, core. Benchmark sorts leave out plans not benchmarked.

tools.name: get-vps-plan
tools.description: One VPS plan as its page on vpscast.com shows it: specs, the full monthly price in USD and stock in each data center, our benchmark score and rank, the benchmark figures in each data center we ran it in, and, where runs got different CPUs, the figures by CPU.

plan.description: The plan id "{provider}/{plan}" as in its page URL, for example "hetzner/cx23"; find-vps gives ids.

tools.name: compare-vps-plans
tools.description: Two VPS plans side by side: specs, the cheapest full monthly price in USD, our benchmark score, and each key benchmark (the median over the data centers we ran the plan in) with which plan is ahead and by how much. With the comparison page on vpscast.com.

first.description: A plan id "{provider}/{plan}" as in its page URL, for example "hetzner/cx23".

second.description: The other plan id, for example "vultr/vc2-2c-4gb".

tools.name: vps-rankings
tools.description: The benchmark rankings of vpscast.com within a size class (by vCPUs): VPS plans by speed per dollar of the full monthly price, or by speed. Only plans with a full score; each with its score, price, how many runs and data centers the score rests on, and its page.

vcpu.description: vCPUs of the size class: 1, 2, 3–4 or 5 and more (2 by default).

by.description: value: speed per dollar (default); score: speed.

tools.name: vps-near-exchange
tools.description: Where to host a trading bot for a crypto exchange: the data centers we measured nearest to its API first, with the round trip in ms (median and the slowest one in ten), when it was measured, and the cheapest VPS with 1 GB of RAM or more sold there. Says where the exchange refuses a country. With the exchange page on vpscast.com.

exchange.description: The exchange, by its slug: "binance", "bybit", "okx" and so on.

limit.description: Data centers to return, nearest first; 5 by default.
